title: Dungeon Game
description: Find the minimum initial health needed to reach the bottom-right dungeon room given a grid of health modifiers.
pseudocode:
1: rows = dungeon.length, cols = dungeon[0].length
2: dp = new Array(rows).fill(0).map(() => new Array(cols).fill(0))
3: dp[rows-1][cols-1] = Math.max(1, 1 - dungeon[rows-1][cols-1])
4: for i = rows-1 down to 0, j = cols-1 down to 0:
5:   if i == rows-1 && j == cols-1 continue
6:   right = (j+1 < cols) ? dp[i][j+1] : Infinity
7:   down = (i+1 < rows) ? dp[i+1][j] : Infinity
8:   dp[i][j] = Math.max(1, Math.min(right, down) - dungeon[i][j])

steps.note: Initialize bottom-right corner: -2 becomes 3, so health 3 needed.
